description: This file implements serialization utilities including string conversions, hex and base64 encoding/decoding, and Unicode code point handling within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts wide-character or character arrays to std::string or std::wstring, handling Unicode conversions.

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Decodes a hexadecimal string into a byte array.

methods.name: CodePointToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 surrogate pairs.

methods.name: UTF16ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 surrogate pairs to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ToCodePoint
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-8 sequence into a Unicode code point.

methods.name: FromCodePoint
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into a UTF-8 sequence.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Escapes internal quotes in a string and wraps it with quotes.
